summary: Frontend testing completed for me&you (French adult content creator platform). Fixed 1 critical bug in Dashboard.jsx. All major flows tested and working: age gate, landing page, auth (login/register), creators list, creator profile, messages, dashboard, verification redirect.

fixed.issue: TypeError: destroy is not a function - useEffect was returning a Promise instead of cleanup function

critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx useEffect bug FIXED - was returning Promise from load() function
Console shows 401 errors on initial page load when not authenticated - this is expected behavior from /api/auth/me check
Stripe Identity redirects to real Stripe URL (not mock mode) - this is correct when Stripe API key supports Identity
seed_data_creation: Created test user during registration flow testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All frontend flows tested and working. Dashboard bug was fixed. Stripe Identity uses real Stripe redirect (not mock mode). The 401 console errors are expected from unauthenticated /api/auth/me calls.
